_provenance: CPIC RYR1 alleles, clinicalfunctionalstatus='Malignant Hyperthermia associated' (api.cpicpgx.org, 2026-06-18). GRCh38/chr19 SNV+MNV subset: 93 of 94 MH alleles. Coords from CPIC sequence_location where present, else Ensembl variant_recoder on NM_000540.3. Non-substitution alleles (1) excluded (VCF-Check matches substitutions). status = ClinVar-style pathogenicity from CPIC allele table. VKORC1/IFNL3 single-SNP defs (rs9923231, rs12979860) from CPIC sequence_location.

snp.note: VKORC1 -1639G>A; A allele = increased warfarin sensitivity (lower dose). Gene on minus strand: genomic C/T = clinical G/A.
IFNL3/IL28B rs12979860; CC = favorable response to PEG-IFN/ribavirin (HCV).
rs12777823 CYP2C cluster; A allele associated with reduced warfarin dose requirement in patients of African ancestry (CPIC warfarin guideline). GRCh38 chr10:94645745 G>A, plus strand (Ensembl).

phenotypes.het: Reduced warfarin dose requirement (G/A) — CYP2C cluster (African-ancestry guidance)
phenotypes.hom: Reduced warfarin dose requirement (A/A) — CYP2C cluster (African-ancestry guidance)

MT-RNR1.provenance: CPIC MT-RNR1 allele table (api.cpicpgx.org/v1/allele, 2026-11-11), CPIC guideline for aminoglycosides and MT-RNR1 (Mc Mahon et al., Clin Pharmacol Ther 2021;109:1458); positions rCRS = GRCh38 chrM, ref bases verified against GRCh38 chrM. Non-substitution alleles excluded (not typed): m.960C>del, m.961T>del, m.961T>del+Cn

G6PD.provenance: PharmCAT 3.2.0 bundled G6PD allele definitions (ClinPGx/CPIC, definition version 2026-02-09-10-28, GRCh38) and CPIC G6PD guideline (Gammal et al., Clin Pharmacol Ther 2023;113:973). Alleles are matched by exact POS/REF/ALT; B (reference) = no allele-defining variant.
